CASE_CONTEXT: PT Asuransi Nusantara Sejahtera (ANS) is a multi-line insurer that sells life, health, motor and property policies through agents, bancassurance partners, brokers and an online channel. Policy non-renewal and lapse rose from 15.2% in 2022 to 20.6% in 2024, and the Board has asked for an explanation of who is leaving, when and why, together with a retention programme for 2026 within a budget of Rp1.5 billion.
CHURN_DEFINITION: a policy that was not renewed or lapsed within the observation window (January 2022 – June 2025)
CASE_QUESTIONS: What are the main drivers of churn, and how large is each effect?
When during the customer lifecycle is churn risk highest?
How accurately can churn be predicted for the customers in the test set?
Which retention programme within the Rp1.5 billion budget maximises the financial return?
